recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-expand ProvenanceActivityType unless Security WG explicitly reverses FHIR-32517 or creates a new broader Provenance activity vocabulary.
issue_request: FHIR-23712 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification and requested adding object-lifecycle events, all DocumentCompletion, all DataOperation, an ObligationPolicy/ActCode subset, all ActStatus, and FHIR event-status codes to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/provenance-activity-type.
initial_application: Git commit 4b5110aec85b16ae627e96a9bbfa7bf910c1b796 created source/terminologies/valueset-provenance-activity-type.xml with inline FHIR-23712 comments and the broad include list requested by the issue.
additional_context: FHIR-32517 later found the same value set incoherent as a broad/extensible grab-bag and was Published with a resolution to change Provenance.activity to an example binding and reduce ProvenanceActivityType to 6-10 ISO 21089 lifecycle example codes. Commit cd1c06923912f70a88c90d186ff3283b40e0403b applied that later decision. FHIR-55798 and FHIR-55797 later refined the current example value set description and added destroy without restoring the broad includes.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Re-adding the FHIR-23712 include set would undo the later final FHIR-32517 decision and conflict with the current example-bound sample design.
